tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards. Dark is pure black (OLED friendly). Also the browser theme-color.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Step cards, sticky table headers, the phone action bar and per-row cards on phones.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Inside text fields, selects and the drop zone at rest.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, card, field, accent-soft, fixed-bg and warn-bg (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hints, field labels, legends, footer and sub-labels on bg, card, field and accent-soft (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: card outlines, table row rules, list items. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: secondary buttons, fields, pills, the dashed drop zone, the phone bar top rule (3.2:1 or better on card, field, bg).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The register green. Primary buttons, selected pills, link buttons, step-number ink, mapped-field outline and the focus ring. Text on card/bg/accent-soft passes 5.6:1.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button, selected tab, selected language). Dark theme uses near-black because the accent lightens.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind step numbers and badges, and the drop zone while hovered or dragged over.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Success message fill; pairs with ok-ink and an accent start border.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text in success messages, on ok-bg only.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Warning message fill and the 'looks wrong: please check' cell fill.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text in warnings and problem notes, on warn-bg (9:1).

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Warning start border, the underline on problem cells and the border of a row card that needs checking.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error message fill; hover fill of remove (×) buttons.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on error-bg and the hovered remove (×) glyph.

tokens.name: fixed-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of a value the app corrected automatically (blue cell).

tokens.name: fixed-line
tokens.usage: Underline of corrected cells and the 'corrected' note text on card (6.6:1).

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Printed-page previews stay white paper in both themes.

tokens.name: sheet-ink
tokens.usage: Ink on printed-page previews, on sheet only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one h1 in the top bar. 21px on phones (title-phone).

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: Card h2 beside the step number. 17px on phones.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: h3 above a group of fields, in muted.

styles.name: body-phone
styles.usage: Body and every field under 700px; 16px stops iPhone Safari zooming into fields.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: Matches are guessed from the column titles and remembered for next time.
styles.usage: Explanations under a step title, field labels, map-row labels; muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Source hints under fields and per-cell notes on phones.

spacing.note: The source spaces on a loose 2px rhythm; values are kept exact.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, list item margins.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label-to-field gap; legend row gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons, pills and tab labels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between top-bar actions and between pills.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap in button rows (.row), message padding, list item padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Field grid row gap; phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Pill and tab side padding; phone card padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between step cards; top-bar gap.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Card vertical padding; button side padding; gap between field groups.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card side padding; top-bar top padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop; drop zone vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Footer bottom padding; step disc size.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Preview area bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-swatch
tokens.usage: Legend swatches.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Inline inputs inside the review table.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, selects, messages, the remove (×) button.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, file list items and the table frame.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards and the drop zone (the source's --radius); per-row cards on phones.

tokens.name: radius-card-phone
tokens.usage: Step cards under 700px wide.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Language toggle, theme button, tabs and badges.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Only on printed-page previews (paper on the desk). Cards use a line border, not a shadow.

controlHeight.note: Minimum heights; every tap target is 40px or more.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Buttons, and every field on phones.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Fields, pills, tabs, checkbox rows and the remove (×) button on desktop.

tokens.name: control-cell
tokens.usage: Inline inputs in the review table on desktop.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the top bar, the step column and the preview area.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: Below this the layout switches to phone mode (one column, row cards, bottom action bar).
